summary: Restrict individual bot apps to admins only.

features.title: Admin-only apps in the bot
features.short: Hide a bot app from everyone but admins
features.description: Mark an app in the bot menu as admin only and it becomes visible — and usable — only to Telegram accounts linked to an Apps Hub admin profile. Useful when the same bot serves both your household and yourself. Without a subscription the checkbox is still there and still remembers its value; it simply does not restrict anything, and every app in the bot stays visible to all linked accounts.
